text:
Situation: Irinotecan hydrochloride is in short supply at Corvale General. Current inventory is 64 units with a daily use of 2.9, providing 22 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list records that Ingenus Pharmaceuticals LLC discontinued irinotecan hydrochloride with an initial posting date of 2026-02-24 and a status of To Be Discontinued. The listed reason is a business decision to discontinue manufacture of the drug. The Northstar Rx LLC label (NDC 16714013101) names Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3009056604) as the registered plant for analysis and manufacture, with a last inspection classification of NAI on 2023-07-28. FDA inspection history for Gland Pharma Limited shows VAI classifications on 2013-08-05, 2015-06-30, and 2019-11-01.

Our position: Supply is limited to approximately three weeks. No other manufacturer is currently listed on FDA's shortage list for this product. Alternative suppliers exist but their manufacturing sites are not identified on available labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to contact Actavis Pharma, Inc., Apotex Corp., BluePoint Laboratories, Eugia US LLC, and Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC to confirm availability, pricing, and manufacturing site information; buyer approves purchase orders.
2. Buyer to verify product authenticity and supply chain reliability for any new source; pharmacy director approves vendor qualification.
3. Buyer to report confirmed lead times and allocation limits to the P&T committee; committee chair acknowledges receipt.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or dose modifications are recommended by the buyer; those decisions rest with treating clinicians and the committee.
